title: EUV lithography systems
supported_claims: 13.5 nm; tin droplets; two laser pulses; 50,000 pulses/s; reflective optics; 4x reticle reduction; vacuum; quarter-nanometre wafer-stage specification and 20,000 measurements/corrections per second

title: Light and lasers — lithography principles
supported_claims: 25 micrometre tin droplets at about 70 m/s; two laser pulses; EUV at 13.5 nm; up to 50,000 times per second
caveats: Manufacturer technical explainer; source parameters are specific to ASML EUV.

title: EUV lithography: the light behind the digital age
supported_claims: Molybdenum/silicon multilayer mirrors; reflectivity up to about 70%; EUV absorption by ordinary glass and air
caveats: Optics-supplier explanation; up to 70% is not total optical-path transmission.

title: How microchips are made
supported_claims: Hundreds of production steps; up to 100 layers; EUV for intricate layers and DUV for other layers; overlay alignment
caveats: Overview; actual layer counts and tool mixes vary by design.

title: Mechanics and mechatronics — lithography principles
supported_claims: Wafer stage, sensors, measurement, reticle/wafer motion
caveats: Manufacturer explainer; do not generalize one tool specification to all factories.

title: TWINSCAN EXE:5000
supported_claims: 0.55 NA; 8 nm resolution specification; 1.7x feature and 2.9x density vendor comparisons versus NXE
caveats: Vendor specifications and comparisons; not a chip-node conversion or guaranteed design density.

title: High-NA EUV reaches new readiness milestone with first high-volume Logic product
supported_claims: Intel Foundry high-volume manufacturing on selected Intel 18A layers for a subset of Core Ultra Series 3 processors
caveats: Company announcement; selected layers and product subset only.

title: Intel Foundry and ASML collaborate to accelerate industry readiness for High-NA EUV
supported_claims: More than one million wafers across certification/testing, R&D and production on selected layers for a subset of products
caveats: Not one million finished chips or one million volume-production wafers.

title: High-NA EUV resist demonstrations
supported_claims: Experimental single-exposure High-NA test structures with 22 nm line/space pitch and 28 nm via spacing
caveats: Test structure metrics, not transistor width or a commercial process-node name.
